alert: Checkout timeouts, 38% 5xx rate
root_cause: Redis connection pool exhaustion due to a flash sale traffic spike
fix: Raised Redis max_connections from 50 to 200 and restarted payments-api workers

alert: p99 latency above 4s, pods OOMKilled
root_cause: Memory leak in the query cache introduced in release v3.8.0
failed_fixes: Increased pod memory limit from 2Gi to 4Gi, pods still crashed after 6 hours
fix: Rolled back to v3.7.4 and disabled the query cache via feature flag

alert: Replica lag above 300s, stale reads on dashboard
root_cause: Long-running analytics query holding locks on the orders table
failed_fixes: Restarted the replica, lag returned within 10 minutes
fix: Killed the analytics query and moved reporting jobs to a dedicated read replica

alert: Disk usage 98% on ip-10-0-2-41, writes failing
root_cause: Log rotation misconfigured after a config management change, debug logs never rotated
fix: Manually cleared logs older than 3 days and restored the logrotate config

alert: HTTPS handshake failures for all mobile clients
root_cause: TLS certificate for api.acmepay.example expired, auto-renewal job had been failing silently for 30 days
fix: Issued a new certificate manually and reloaded the gateway; added an expiry alert at 21 days

alert: Kafka consumer lag above 2 million messages
root_cause: Poison message with malformed JSON caused the consumer to crash-loop and retry the same offset
failed_fixes: Scaled consumers from 4 to 12, all crash-looped on the same message
fix: Skipped the bad offset, routed it to the dead-letter topic, and added schema validation

alert: Users randomly logged out, spike in 401 responses
root_cause: NTP drift of 94s between auth-service pods caused JWT validation failures
failed_fixes: Restarted auth-service pods, issue returned after two hours
fix: Escalated as clock skew; resolved together with INC-1008

alert: Recurring random logouts, 102s clock skew between pods
root_cause: NTP drift on node ip-10-0-3-17 caused by a stopped chrony service
fix: Restarted chrony on ip-10-0-3-17 and cordoned the node until time synced

alert: Checkout page blank for 15% of users after deploy
root_cause: Frontend bundle referenced a feature flag missing in production config
failed_fixes: Cleared the CDN cache, no effect
fix: Added the missing flag to production config and redeployed; added a CI check for flag parity

alert: Connection count at max, application errors 'too many clients'
root_cause: Connection leak in reports-service after v1.9.2, connections never returned to the pool
failed_fixes: Increased max_connections from 200 to 400, exhausted again in 90 minutes
fix: Rolled back reports-service to v1.9.1 and killed idle connections; fixed the leak in code the next day

alert: Email delivery delayed by over 40 minutes
root_cause: Third-party email provider rate-limited the account after a bulk campaign
fix: Throttled the campaign sender to 50 msg/s and enabled the backup provider for transactional mail

alert: Search returning empty results for all queries
root_cause: Elasticsearch index alias pointed at an empty index after a failed reindex job
fix: Repointed the alias to the previous index and fixed the reindex job to swap only after validation

alert: 502 errors from gateway, upstream connect timeouts
root_cause: Kubernetes node group autoscaler stuck, pods unschedulable due to insufficient CPU
failed_fixes: Restarted the gateway deployment, pods stayed Pending
fix: Manually added two nodes and raised the autoscaler max size from 6 to 10

alert: Intermittent payment declines, upstream gateway timeouts
root_cause: DNS resolution failures for the card processor after CoreDNS pods were evicted
fix: Restarted CoreDNS and set a pod disruption budget so at least two replicas always run

alert: Latency spike and Redis connection errors after deploy v2.14.3
root_cause: Redis connection pool exhausted again; v2.14.3 opened a new connection per request and never released it
failed_fixes: Raised max_connections from 200 to 400 (worked for the earlier INC-1001 pattern), pool exhausted again within 40 minutes
fix: Rolled back to v2.14.2; connection leak patched in v2.14.4

alert: Nightly reconciliation job failed with exit code 137
root_cause: Job container OOMKilled because the batch size grew with order volume
fix: Reduced the batch size from 10000 to 2000 and raised the memory limit to 3Gi

alert: Login failures for SSO users, 503 from identity provider callback
root_cause: Identity provider changed its signing keys and the JWKS cache in auth-service was stale
failed_fixes: Restarted pods, cache reloaded the same stale keys from a shared Redis entry
fix: Flushed the JWKS cache key and lowered its TTL from 24h to 15 minutes

alert: Disk usage 91% and rising on db-primary
root_cause: WAL files accumulating because a replication slot was inactive after a replica was decommissioned
fix: Dropped the orphaned replication slot and allowed WAL to be recycled

alert: Slow page loads, CDN cache hit ratio dropped from 92% to 40%
root_cause: A new Vary header on API responses fragmented the CDN cache
failed_fixes: Purged the CDN cache, hit ratio dropped again within minutes
fix: Removed the Vary: Cookie header from static endpoints and redeployed the config

alert: Push notifications not delivered, queue depth growing
root_cause: Expired APNs credential after annual certificate rotation was missed
failed_fixes: Restarted the worker deployment, no effect
fix: Uploaded the renewed APNs key and added a calendar plus alert for credential expiry
